post.description: Checks the admin password and starts an admin session.
Ends the current session.

get.description: Returns whether the current session is authenticated.
Returns the configured overlay PNG, or 404 if none is configured.
Streams the live camera preview as multipart/x-mixed-replace MJPEG.

post.description: Opens a new run and returns its number and the number of captures it expects. Fails with 409 while another client's run is open.

delete.description: Deletes every capture stored for a run and closes it if it is still open.

post.description: Captures a still (backend camera sources) or accepts an uploaded still (webcam source) and stores it as the next image of run. Fails with 409 if run is not the currently open run.

get.description: Serves one stored capture of a run as JPEG.
Serves the screen version of one capture of a run as JPEG, with the overlay drawn in.
Returns the effective application configuration with the default and the source of each setting. Secrets are returned empty (Admin only).

put.description: Validates the submitted configuration and writes it to the config file. Does not apply to the running process, a restart is required (Admin only).

post.description: Builds the submitted cloud share configuration and verifies it is reachable, without saving it (Admin only).
Builds the submitted storage configuration and verifies it is reachable, without saving it (Admin only).

get.description: Lists the stored runs of an event, or of every event without one, paginated and most recent first (Admin only).
Lists the events with stored runs, most recent first, with the event of the booth marked as current (Admin only).
Streams every stored capture of an event as one zip archive, or their originals without the overlay (Admin only).

parameters.description: Download the originals without the overlay
parameters.name: originals

delete.description: Deletes every stored capture for a run (Admin only).

get.description: Serves one stored capture of a run as JPEG (Admin only).
Serves the original of one capture of a run, stored without the overlay, as JPEG (Admin only).
Streams every stored capture of a run as a zip archive, or its originals without the overlay (Admin only).

parameters.description: Download the originals without the overlay
parameters.name: originals

get.description: Returns the public configuration of the application.
Lists every stored overlay PNG (Admin only).

post.description: Stores an uploaded PNG as a new overlay (Admin only).

get.description: Downloads a stored overlay PNG by name (Admin only).

delete.description: Removes a stored overlay by name. The overlay drawn over the captures cannot be deleted (409) (Admin only).

get.description: Returns "pong" if the API is up and running.

post.description: Cancels every job of a CUPS printer queue (Admin only).

get.description: Lists every stored print layout available to compose a run's captures onto (Admin only).
Returns one stored print layout with its pages and slots (Admin only).

put.description: Validates and stores the submitted layout under id, creating it if it doesn't exist yet (Admin only).

delete.description: Removes a stored print layout by id. The layout configured for printing cannot be deleted (Admin only).

get.description: Lists every CUPS printer queue known to the system (Admin only).

post.description: Enables a CUPS printer queue again and releases its held jobs, for example after the printer stopped it because of an error (Admin only).
Verifies that the submitted CUPS printer queue exists and is not disabled, without printing anything (Admin only).

get.description: Lists the captures and collage pages of a shared run as signed URLs.
Streams the captures and collage pages of a shared run as a zip archive.
Reports the current state of a run's cloud upload and its link once it is done.

post.description: Starts sharing a run as a link in the background, uploading its captures to the configured cloud share provider first. Poll GET on the same path for the result. Only available when a cloud share is configured.

get.description: Reports the current state of the latest email of a run.

post.description: Starts emailing every capture of a run to the given address as attachments in the background. Poll GET on the same path for the result. Only available when email sharing is enabled.

get.description: Reports the current state of the latest print of a run. A failed print names its reason, queue_unavailable if the printer queue did not accept it.

post.description: Starts composing the captures of a run onto the configured print layout and submitting it to the configured CUPS printer queue in the background. Poll GET on the same path for the result. Only available when printing is enabled.
Runs the configured system.all_restart_command. Disabled (400) when none is configured (Admin only).
Runs the configured system.all_stop_command. Disabled (400) when none is configured (Admin only).
Reboots the host machine directly (Admin only).
Powers off the host machine directly (Admin only).

get.description: Reports host and process metrics for the admin dashboard (Admin only).

post.description: Runs the configured system.kiosk_restart_command. Disabled (400) when none is configured (Admin only).
Runs the configured system.kiosk_stop_command. Disabled (400) when none is configured (Admin only).
Gracefully exits the running application process directly. Whether it comes back up depends on its supervisor, such as the restart policy of a service (Admin only).
Runs the configured system.server_restart_command. Disabled (400) when none is configured (Admin only).
Runs the configured system.server_stop_command. Disabled (400) when none is configured (Admin only).

get.description: Compares the running version with the latest release and reports whether this installation can install it itself (Admin only).

post.description: Starts installing the latest release in the background and answers right away. The application restarts once it is installed, see the update status (Admin only).

get.description: Returns the state of the last update started on this instance (Admin only).

clearSecrets.description: ClearSecrets lists the JSON paths of secrets to remove. A secret sent empty otherwise keeps its value.

name.description: Name is the flag, the environment variable, or the file path, empty for the default.

fontSizePt.description: FontSizePt and Color are optional. Left unset, the caption is drawn with domain.DefaultBrandingFontSizePt in black.

x.description: X/Y are the center of the caption on the page (0..1, same convention as LayoutSlotRequest).

widthMM.description:
WidthMM/HeightMM are capped at 500mm: RenderCollage allocates a canvas of mm/25.4*renderDPI pixels per side,
so an unbounded value risks running out of memory on a device with little RAM.
500mm covers any realistic print size.

slots.description: Slots is the total slot count summed across every page.

locked.description: Locked only keeps the slot in place in the editor, printing ignores it.
Locked only keeps the slot in place in the editor, printing ignores it.

messageIdDomain.description: MessageIDDomain mirrors the rule of the mail section of the config package: a bare domain name.

instance.description:
Instance changes with every start of the backend, so the kiosk notices a restart that applied a new configuration
although the version stayed the same.

imageUrls.description: ImageURLs are signed URLs of the captures followed by the collage pages, valid for a limited time.

commands.description: Commands are the configured commands of the system actions, an empty one disables its action.
